annotations.title: List case statuses, priorities or types

description: List the instance's case statuses (id, label, type), priorities (id, label, level) or types (id, label, type) — the ids needed for status_id / priority_id / type_id when creating, updating or replying to a case. Kayako: GET /api/v1/cases/{statuses|priorities|types}.json.
name: kayako_list_case_options
title: List case statuses, priorities or types
